description: §22.12 closed allow-list (S457) — a computed member access with a non-literal key (`emit[k]`) inside a `^{}` body is E-META-001: the key's value cannot be known to avoid `constructor` / `__proto__` / `prototype` (here it is built to equal `constructor`). An element is read with `x.at(i)`, a collection iterated with `for … of`, a keyed lookup made with a Map's `.get(k)`.
